InstitutionRejected.subject: Your institution request was not approved
InstitutionRejected.html:
❌ Institution Rejected

We appreciate your interest in joining MedSync. However, after reviewing your institution {{InstitutionName}}, we were unable to approve your registration at this time.

This may be due to incomplete information, missing verification details, or other eligibility requirements.

If you believe this decision was made in error or would like more information, please contact us at contact@medsync.com.
